title: Eight Bars To A Line
countOff: Guitar: 2 bars of the intro riff, band in on the downbeat
notes: Medium pocket, straight eighths. Nobody rushes the pre-chorus.
Keys take the solo the second time through if we're feeling it.

sections.name: intro
notes: Guitar alone for 4, full band joins at bar 5.

lyrics: Three in the morning and the flexbox finally lands,
eight bars to a line and the chords all understand.
I never read the dots but I hear the changes fine,
so I typed it into JSON and it printed out in time.

sections.name: prechorus
notes: Build. Hi-hat opens on the last bar.

lyrics: No more docs with a table full of hacks —
the song's a shape, and the shape is coming back.
Vibe code the chart, let the color do the talking,
eight bars in a row and the whole band keeps on walking.
Print it, prop it, stand it on the stand —
a song shaped like a song, finally in my hand.
Verse one, verse two, they number on their own,
a slash in the empty bar so no one plays alone.
The lyrics found the phrase like they always should have done,
and the date down in the footer says we're only version one.
No more squinting at a photocopied page —
it's letter size and lit up on the stage.
Vibe code the chart, let the color do the talking,
eight bars in a row and the whole band keeps on walking.
Print it, prop it, stand it on the stand —
a song shaped like a song, finally in my hand.

sections.name: bridge
notes: Half time. Everybody down to a whisper, drums on rims.

lyrics: Take it down, half time, everybody breathe —
the chart don't need the notes to tell you what to leave.

sections.name: solo
notes: 16 bars. Guitar first time, keys second. Rhythm section keeps the chorus groove.

sections.name: chorus
notes: Two singers up an octave. Guitar drops to skank.

lyrics: Vibe code the chart, let the color do the talking,
eight bars in a row and the whole band keeps on walking.
Print it, prop it, stand it on the stand —
a song shaped like a song, finally in my hand.
Vamp it till the leader puts a hand up in the air...

endNotes: Ending: on the cutoff, everybody stops on the downbeat of G. Let it ring.
If the room's still with us, take the chorus one more time a cappella.
